title: Plumber Game
description: Dive into the ocean and become a plumber of the extreme in Sea Plumber. Put your brain to the trial in this puzzle game, repair the pipes in the deep and become the champion of plumbing. Sea Plumber is an amusing game for the whole family! Only recommended for... everyone!
